text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. They give team members a chance to check each other's work before it goes live. One major benefit is catching bugs early, when they are easier and cheaper to fix. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because reviewers learn new techniques and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by keeping the code clean and consistent. When everyone takes part, the whole team improves together and delivers better, more reliable software.
